strings.title: Sacred Gold Plus {version} - project cheats - {locale}
strings.intro: This catalogue contains only the project’s optional codes for the exact current ROM identified above. It does not import the historical third-party cheat database. A matching melonDS game ID alone does not establish compatibility: the full ROM SHA-256 must also match.
strings.validation: The complete ROM identity, unchanged equality guards and native bytes at every affected static address were checked for this target. This is static revision verification. The effects have not been retested through every scene, saving and cold restart on this version; overlay loading and emulator cheat execution still affect runtime behavior.
strings.controls: All codes start off. Try one at a time on disposable copies of the ROM and raw save, keeping your original files. Generating these files does not change an installed catalogue or its activation states. Do not combine these entries with older versions of the same codes.
strings.persistence: Turning a code off does not undo writes already made to RAM. Fully restart the game without the code and without a modified savestate to restore the original instructions. Changes saved to the raw save, such as a Pokémon’s new nickname, remain after restarting.
strings.native_features: Plus difficulty, wild levels, battle animation settings, training tools, shiny settings, the Guide and Box commands are native game features. They do not need these codes. Keep your existing Plus settings when updating; a cheat is not a settings migration.
strings.xml_install: XML: for compatible melonDS Android importers. Check the complete ROM hash first, then import manually for this game. Existing imports and activation states belong to your emulator; avoid a global reimport that resets them. Each code is inside a folder for importers that ignore entries at the game’s root.
strings.mch_install: MCH: for compatible desktop melonDS versions. On a test installation, use the ROM’s basename for the .mch file beside that ROM, following the emulator’s configured cheat location. CODE 0 means disabled. Do not overwrite an existing personal catalogue without keeping a copy. READ the notes before enabling a code.
strings.mch_note: Read README.txt for this code’s instructions, interactions and limits. Only static revision checks were performed.
strings.runtime: Not exported: this code follows a save-block pointer in running memory. Its current address and write target have not been verified at runtime on this exact revision. Static ROM matching cannot establish that pointer’s safety.
strings.preimage: Not exported: at least one native preimage, equality guard or affected address is missing, ambiguous or different on this target. The original code and guards have not been rewritten to force a match.
strings.preimages: Native static preimages checked for this exact ROM (region, address, byte count, SHA-256)
strings.credits: These optional project codes retain their existing instruction streams. Thanks to the project and its community contributors. The historical third-party database and its thousands of unrelated entries are not included; their original authors retain their credits.
strings.fast_text.name: Fast text
strings.fast_text.note: Speeds up native dialogue and may override the game’s Text Speed setting. Custom Plus pages and the Guide have their own input handling. Disabling the entry alone does not restore patched instructions; fully restart without the code.
strings.transitions.name: Fast transitions
strings.transitions.note: Shortens native map-change fades. It does not unlock the frame rate or increase rendering resolution. Restart without the code to restore the original instructions.
strings.healing.name: Fast healing
strings.healing.note: Shortens Pokémon Center healing animations; HP, status conditions and PP are restored normally. The second guard belongs to overlay 2 and can act only while that overlay is loaded. This does not establish coverage of every healing scene.
strings.outlines.name: Hide 3D outlines
strings.outlines.note: Disables 3D edge marking while keeping the existing Nintendo DS anti-aliasing; it does not increase resolution. Enter and leave a building after enabling it. Its equality guard belongs to overlay 1, so the effect depends on that overlay being loaded.
strings.rename.name: Rename traded Pokémon
strings.rename.note: Lets the Name Rater rename Pokémon received from other Trainers. A nickname persists if you save the game. Turning the code off or restarting does not undo a saved name change.
strings.money.name: Money 999999 (SELECT)
strings.money.note: The historical code intends to set money to 999999 when SELECT is pressed and would preserve that value if saved. It is omitted because the runtime save-block pointer and write target have not been established for this revision. No money code is exported.
strings.camera.name: Classic camera
strings.camera.note: Requests HeartGold’s original camera angles outdoors as well. The game already uses the native camera in 52 interiors and caves. The change takes effect on the next map change and writes the camera state at 0x023DFFFC after its module guard matches. Fully restarting without the code restores the game’s normal camera policy without clearing Plus settings. The visible effect has not been retested on this revision.
